items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: Then I did ... with Jackie Wilson. As a matter of fact, I made all of his records.

ctx.x: Then I did "Baby Work Out," "Reek-a-Teek," "Reet Petite," "Night," and "Danny Boy," with Jackie Wilson. As a matter of fact, I made all of his records.
Yeah, I think I was on quite a few of those myself.
